clues.it: Anna era accanto a un gargoyle.
Paolo era l'unico seduto su uno sgabello.
clues.en: Paolo was the only one sitting on a stool.

clues.it: Dario era da solo in Armeria.
clues.en: Dario was alone in the Armory.
Bruno was beside a suit of armor.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era l'unica persona su una runa.
clues.en: Fabio was the only person on a glowing rune.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 4th.

steps.it: Bruno può stare solo nella 1ª colonna: escludendola, a Anna resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Bruno can only be in the 1st column: ruling it out leaves Anna a single square: row 1st, column 2nd.

steps.it: Fabio può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Paolo resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Paolo a single square: row 2nd, column 6th.

steps.it: Giada può stare solo nella 5ª riga.
steps.en: Giada can only be in the 5th row.
